title: Zanabazar Square on Romenagri's pivot
summary: A table taking Romenagri's ACII pivot to Zanabazar Square and back, so every sutra can be read in Zanabazar Square. The round trip must be lossless on all 3,983 sutras.
licence: Our own table (CC0-1.0), derived from the Unicode Character Database, cited.
how: Write tables/romenagri/<code>.csv with columns acii (hex, like A4) and char (the script's character or sequence), one row per ACII value the sutras use.
Derive each character from the Unicode Character Database by name; cite the version.
Run the acceptance command: every sutra's ACII must go to the script and come back unchanged.
